description: This is a PHP source file for an 'Add Port Forwarding' web page in a router or network device configuration interface. It includes server-side PHP code to gather device information and client-side JavaScript to handle form validation, user interactions, and AJAX submission for adding port forwarding rules.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Converts an IPv6 address string with '::' shorthand into an expanded array of 8 segments.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks if form fields with a specific prefix are blank, excluding certain fields.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates values of input fields with IDs starting with given prefix, separated by specified separator.

methods.name: isIp6AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv6 address fields are required based on current form state.

methods.name: isIp4AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv4 address fields are required based on current form state.
